findings.evidence: `rg` finds the required pro-`p` declarations at `MaximalProP.lean:139` and `:159`, but no corresponding declarations in `ProC.lean`; `README.md:371` requires the API of `proPKernel`, and `README.md:390` names the trivial-only class/completion case.
findings.fix: Add `proCKernel_eq_top_iff` and `proCCompletion.subsingleton_iff`; expose the trivial-only `FiniteGroupClass` with its membership simp lemma and derive its completion edge case.
findings.issue: The public API has no analogue of `proPKernel_eq_top_iff` or `maximalProPQuotient.subsingleton_iff`, so users cannot characterize when a pro-`C` completion is trivial without unfolding; the roadmap explicitly requires the `proPKernel` API and the class containing only trivial groups as an edge case.

summary: The pro-`C` kernel omits the trivial-completion portion of the required `proPKernel` API and the roadmap’s trivial-class edge case.
